review_role: New clean independent source/key, exact asked scope and coverage-stopping review
scope: Original 2017 base/core all nine species; optional variants and Remastered excluded. Printed-card inputs/outputs still read from physical cards; no all-card memorization requirement.

independence.basis: Only the four named current bank files, source manifest, original authorities and allowed provenance. No expected verdict supplied. Prior zero-addition count treated as a claim to challenge, not evidence of completeness.

method: Read the complete current question bank, expected answers, all required facts, contextual background and full current map. Rewalked original booklet pp1–10, all nine species fronts and Faderan reverse, accepted actual phase/relic imagery and complete primary author clarifications. Audited facts against actual question clauses, including false material context, and independently searched for consequential untargeted procedures, timings, priorities, permissions and exceptions. Concrete outcomes count as exercising their rules without requiring a second formula/method recital.

challenge_dispositions.candidate: Ordinary colony-climate eligibility beyond discard handling
challenge_dispositions.reason: Q36 asks exact jungle-colony input; Q27 asks changed climate and Q28 handles matching-climate consumed-colony cycling. Another wrong-climate example is ordinary application, not a source exception.

challenge_dispositions.candidate: Initial colony-track fill direction, absent as a separate Q22 atom
challenge_dispositions.reason: Q22 tests lowest-minimum-upward initial technology dealing; original p4 explicitly uses the same dealing procedure for both tracks. Another deck name is not a new governing procedure.

challenge_dispositions.candidate: Additional printed support or entry/output quantities for ordinary cards
challenge_dispositions.reason: Read actual printed cards during play. Network loan/Im’dril exception is tested; ordinary +2 support and other ordinary outputs do not add a new procedure.
Q06 asks whether one converter output may fund another in the same Economy, without restricting goods to cubes. Naming this ordinary converter adds no exception.

challenge_dispositions.candidate: Cache large-cube input rather than small-cube input
challenge_dispositions.reason: Original discount groups small and large cubes under one-cube reduction; Q39 exercises cube reduction against octagon exclusion. Changing cube size introduces no independent branch.

challenge_dispositions.candidate: General relic loans and their return timing
challenge_dispositions.reason: Q03 tests species-background loans; Q37 tests an actual ordinary relic loan; Q62 tests the explicit Detector nontrade exception and Q42 the backgroundless Gift exception.

challenge_dispositions.candidate: Acknowledgment distribution permission and envoy stash trade permission
challenge_dispositions.reason: Q74 and Q78 independently ask the positive permissions; they are not credited from unrelated circulation prohibitions.
Q77 explicitly asks the token transfer in addition to the resource bundle; Q49 grouping alone would not establish this coverage.
Q80 expressly tests later opportunities at resulting ranks; Q16 background alone would not cover it.

challenge_dispositions.candidate: General symbol timing, donation classification and public technology record
challenge_dispositions.reason: Q76, Q70 and Q71 expressly test these items; earlier context-only mentions receive no extra credit.

challenge_dispositions.candidate: Final scoring reminder arrows run only once
challenge_dispositions.reason: Q10 scores multiple octagons and large pairs, so its three-point result requires applying formula to all groups. A separate narration of the designer’s reminder explanation is not an omission gate.

challenge_dispositions.candidate: Final Envoys output versus normal final donations
challenge_dispositions.reason: Q10 asks last-Economy donations. Original primary author says players keep their own donation goods; no source-defined contrary final-envoy exception was imported.

challenge_dispositions.candidate: Optional scoring fractions, timed trading, handicapping, later editions and unsupported hypothetical interactions
challenge_dispositions.reason: Outside authorized original core scope or lacking a distinct positive source-supported rule.

coverage_stopping.conclusion: No consequential source procedure survives only in unasked key context after considering the full current bank. No cosmetic numerical/name variants, ordinary per-card quantities, physical recitals or unsupported hypotheses justify reopening.
